descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group IT Engineering Specialist is responsible for developing and maintaining software and cloud-based applications, ensuring performance, security, and scalability. This role supports project delivery and contributes to technical innovation. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Purpose of the Job (summarized) To ensure the continued development and support of Application Integration portfolio within the business organisation. Ensuring that the business is kept at an efficient, functioning state regarding its integrated applications applications / processes. We need Integration Developer in our Sales Tools team, reporting to the AGM Sales Tools, Global Delivery Center within the Global IT Team. We are looking for a self-driven. Integration Developer Your job General Tasks:
• Develop and maintain Application Integration solutions (real-time / batch)
• Supporting and maintaining integration solutions and related components e.g. databases, queues
• Designing and modelling of databases, tables, stored procedures according to solution requirement
• Create / configure / fine tune / monitoring queues (MSMQ, Azure Service Bus queue, ActiveMQ)
• Scheduling and deployment
• Coordinate with different teams for fixing integration issues / new implementations
• Talend monitoring
• Monitoring, fixing non-working and broken jobs
• Monitoring the health of Talend remote engine / run-time servers. Give suggestions accordingly.
• Talend infrastructure; keeping Talend infrastructure up to date according to predefined schedule
• Patching, upgrades, deployment, etc.
• Debugging and optimizing implementations Technical:
• Experience with (a) modern integration platform(s).
• Should be well-versed with SQL (database designing, create tables, stored procedures)
• Hands-on experience with creating / configuring / maintaining ActiveMQ / MSMQ / Azure Service Bus queue
• Developing APIs / web services in Talend
• Knowledge on FTP / SFTP / APIs / WEB services
• Sound knowledge of JSON / XML
• Knowledge of java scripts
• Experience on integration with SAP / Salesforce / MS Dynamics CRM
• Experience with Talend Cloud Real-Time Big Data Platform
• Nice to have – Talend certification; experience with Talend infrastructure, e.g. installation/upgrade of remote engines / runtimes will be an added advantage Experience required in/with:
• Essential – willingness to expand their knowledge of the above
• A globally acting company and working in international project teams
• ~ 10 years overall experience in similar role out of which ~ 6-7 years in Talend
• Integration around Salesforce and SAP
• Salesforce platform events
• Talend data mapper Education/Qualification: o Any graduate with the above-mentioned professional experience We offer In an international environment, you will take over global responsibilities. You will work in an international team and in different cultures. This position enables to further personal development. If you can identify yourself with this challenge, then we would like to get to know you! Location: Global Delivery Center located in Mumbai What we offer you 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays Defined contribution pension scheme Hospitalization insurance benefit On-site car parking Subsidized cafeteria Long service award Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to
